scenarios.prompt: On a reinstalled device, restore a non-consumable and an active subscription using authoritative store/account state, then feed them through the normal idempotent grant path.

criteria.classification: Distinguishes non-consumable, subscription/time-limited and consumable restore semantics.
criteria.idempotency: Replayed restore history flows through the same idempotent grant path.
criteria.failure: Transient restore failure never wipes known-good entitlement state.
